title: WHY WORRY WHEN YOU CAN PRAY

lines.text: Why worry, when you can pray,
Take it all to Jesus, that's the easy way,
Why worry, when you can pray.
Why worry, when you can pray,
Take it all to Jesus that's the easy way,
Why worry, when you can pray.

lyrics:
[Verse]
Why worry, when you can pray,
Take it all to Jesus, that's the easy way,
He'll carry all your burdens,
And drive your fears away,
Why worry, when you can pray.

[Verse]
Why worry, when you can pray,
Take it all to Jesus that's the easy way,
Don't be a doubting Thomas,
Just stand upon His promise,
Why worry, when you can pray.
